checkpoints.question: Which command shows the fields carried by a `std_msgs/msg/String` message?
checkpoints.model_answer: `ros2 interface show std_msgs/msg/String` displays the message definition and its fields.

checkpoints.question: Which command gives a one-message observation of `/chatter`?
checkpoints.model_answer: `ros2 topic echo --once /chatter` waits for one message and then returns.
